# Run the app

Runs the **Dev: Full Stack (web on edge)** task: preflight, start Supabase, wire
`apps/web/.env.local`, and launch the web app at <http://localhost:5173>.

> Requires **Docker** running (for the local Supabase backend). To debug in the
> browser with breakpoints instead, press **F5 → "Web on edge (Microsoft Edge)"**.
